components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Rope facade
components.responsibility: Validate scalar ranges, split weighted tree and join bounded chunks; publish a new balanced root only after a successful edit.

components.label: Bounded leaf chunks
components.responsibility: Store at most B bytes per leaf, splitting on scalar boundaries; retain both byte and scalar length.

components.label: Weighted internal nodes
components.responsibility: Store left scalar weight and total subtree count; subtract left weight only when descending right.

components.label: Weighted split
components.responsibility: Descend by weight, split at a valid scalar boundary, and reconstruct only nodes on the search path.

components.label: Height-aware join
components.responsibility: Join by descending the taller spine; allocate input chunks once and repair path metadata.

components.label: AVL repair
components.responsibility: Apply single or double rotations on repaired paths and recompute heights and weights bottom-up.

components.label: Pinned roots
components.responsibility: Immutable nodes retain old roots; publish the new root in one writer transition. Snapshots own root references.

components.label: Chunk reclamation
components.responsibility: Detach a range structurally in logarithmic navigation work, then account separately for removed-node destruction and retained snapshots.

components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Treap facade
components.responsibility: Use in-order position instead of explicit keys; heap priorities choose structure while subtree counts select positions.

components.label: Treap chunks
components.responsibility: Each treap node owns a bounded scalar chunk plus left/right children and a stable priority.

components.label: Subtree totals
components.responsibility: Store total left/chunk/right scalar counts and repair after changing any child pointer.

components.label: Position split
components.responsibility: Split the chunk into two valid bounded chunks and merge each piece with its corresponding subtree using fresh ordered priorities.

components.label: Priority merge
components.responsibility: Inputs represent consecutive text ranges. Select lower priority root and recursively merge only its touching child; repair counts.

components.label: Range splice
components.responsibility: Insert splits once and merges input; delete splits twice and merges survivors. Read follows subtree ranks without changing root.

components.label: Root publication
components.responsibility: Path-copy changed nodes and atomically publish a new immutable root under a single writer version check.

components.label: Height guard
components.responsibility: Track depth against a declared guard; rebuild with fresh priorities or reject the operation with old root intact. This is a fallback policy with explicit linear rebuild cost.

requirements.text: Read, insert and delete preserve sequence order with checked half-open ranges and scalar indices.
Maintain subtree sizes and the chosen balance invariant after splits and joins.
Account for inserted bytes, removed-node reclamation, snapshots and invalid ranges without promising impossible O(log n) total copying.

problem.scope: Authored local data-structure study. Compare a height-balanced chunk rope with a randomized implicit treap. Positions count Unicode scalar values, not bytes or grapheme clusters. Insertion of m new characters costs at least O(m); deletion that frees m characters may also cost O(m). Sub-linear targets apply to indexed navigation and structural splicing, not input copying or reclamation.
